contexts.statement: OpenAI Math Audit #043: P = W for fixed-determinant SLn moduli spaces.
Audit the full fixed-determinant Betti curious hard Lefschetz theorem via the determinant-root cover, for all composite n>=4, g>=2, gcd(n,d)=1.

definitions.V: ordered determinant-one eigenvalues with no proper nonempty subproduct equal to one
definitions.q: (zeta,...,zeta), zeta a primitive n-th root determined by d
definitions.Gamma: Pic^0(C)[n], with no invariant projector permitted in the transfer
definitions.half-weight: one half of actual Deligne weight

contexts.statement: Finite etale covers of smooth torically stratified complex algebraic families, with all components and deck representations retained.

definitions.f: smooth separated finite-type family of relative complex dimension delta
definitions.relative stratification: finite closed filtration with relative torus-affine vector-bundle differences over S

claims.natural_statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 043 (P = W for fixed-determinant SLn moduli spaces.; papers: P=W in composite rank for fixed determinant; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.
For smooth coprime GL_n moduli, P=W in every rank and genus g>=2; this is prior literature, not a result of this audit.
For prime rank, full SL_p P=W is equivalent to GL_p P=W; this does not discharge composite-rank variant cohomology.
The staged Theorem thm:main asserts full fixed-determinant P_k H^m = W_{2k} H^m = W_{2k+1} H^m for every composite n>=4, g>=2 and coprime degree.

For every composite n>=4, g>=2 and coprime degree, H^*(X^B,Q) is Hodge-Tate, e has nonzero image in Gr^W_4 H^2, and e^i:Gr^W_{2R-2i}H^m -> Gr^W_{2R+2i}H^{m+2i} is an isomorphism for all i>=0,m, on full cohomology.

The actual ordered flagged GL_n family has rank-b auxiliary torus-affine stratifications: at regular semisimple parameters the common compact-support actual-weight center is delta+2b; over the whole generic ordered V including collisions the relative affine-bundle refinements are vector bundles over A^a x (C*)^s x V by projection.

Every connected component of a finite etale cover of a vector bundle over A^a x (C*)^s has rational ordinary and compact-support cohomology isomorphic via pullback to that of the base total space as mixed Hodge structures; disconnected components are retained.

The determinant-root cover of the ordered GL_n family has Hodge-Tate fiber cohomology, regular-semisimple curious Lefschetz center R+b+g, integral ordinary and compact-support local constancy with natural ordinary fiber base change; the local-constancy and Hodge-Tate properties descend to Y^B by product splittings.
The scalar correspondence has A B=(-1)^b n! id, degree and actual-weight shifts plus/minus 2b, and extracts full-cohomology curious Lefschetz of center R+g on X^B x (C*)^{2g}.

For nonzero finite integer-graded V,W in characteristic zero and degree-two E_V,E_W, Lefschetz for E_V tensor 1 + 1 tensor E_W forces each factor to be Lefschetz with centers adding to the total; applied to the determinant factor, its center is g and the remaining center is R.
For composite n>=4 and g>=2, H^0(X,Q)=Q, H^1(X,Q)=0 and H^2(X,Q)=Q e with e nonzero, as in norm:low-cohomology.

Smooth algebraic direct image with lisse ordinary cohomology and natural fiber base change gives variations whose parallel transport preserves the rational weight filtration and cup product; a weight-four Lefschetz class may be transported along a chosen path to q.

The full-cohomology moving-pole construction must supply one f of cohomological degree -2 with fP_k subset P_{k-2}, fW_j subset W_{j-4}, and [[f,e],e]=-2e; this remains outside the present Betti mission.
The staged algebraic comparison and relative hard Lefschetz identify P and half weights once the common lowering operator and C_BETTI_CHL are available.
For smooth coprime GL_n moduli, P=W in every rank and genus g>=2; this is prior literature, not a result of this audit.

claims.natural_statement: For any Q-algebra, central unit a and arbitrary element d, the 2-by-2 blocks D=[[d,0],[a,-d]] and h=[[0,a^-1],[0,0]] satisfy D h+h D=I. When d^2=0 this contracts the complex; applied to character-valued torus Koszul cochains it proves acyclicity whenever one monodromy coefficient is nonzero, in all dimensions and for all n.

If f is smooth separated of finite type over a smooth complex base, of relative dimension delta, and Rf_!Z has bounded locally constant finitely generated cohomology, then it is locally perfect over Z; Rf_*Z is its shifted derived dual, is likewise lisse and finitely generated, and the natural ordinary base-change morphism at every point is an isomorphism, retaining integral Ext terms.

If a smooth finite-type family admits a rank-b auxiliary affine bundle with a finite relative torus-affine closed filtration, and at one parameter a rank-b auxiliary bundle has such strata with one common compact-support Lefschetz class of actual-weight center delta+2b, then every finite etale cover has Hodge-Tate fibers, integral ordinary/compact-support local constancy and natural ordinary base change, and ordinary Lefschetz of actual-weight center delta at that parameter. No lifted component is discarded. On each Galois-covered piece, cohomology is its full component permutation module tensored with the base cohomology; Kummer character summands are computed by the universal Koszul contraction.
